sections.shortTitle: National Commission for Human Development Amendment Ordinance 2009
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE V II 01 2009
ORDINANCE V II 01 2009
NATIONAL COMMISSION FOR
HUMAN DEVELOPMENT
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2009
An Ordinance further to amend the National Commission
for
Human Development Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
26th November, 2009]
No.2(I)/2009-Pub, dated
26-11-2009.---The following Ordinance Promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
Whereas, it is expedient further to amend the
National Commission for Human Development Ordinance, 2002 (XXXIX of 2002);
And whereas, the National Assembly is not in session
and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it
necessary to take immediate action;
Now, Therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred
by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of Islamic Republic of
Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance:--
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may be
called the National Commission for Human Development (Amendment) Ordinance, 2009.
(2) It shall come into force at once and shall be deemed to
have taken effect on and from the 21st July, 2007.

(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2009
An Ordinance further to amend the National Commission
for
Human Development Ordinance, 2002
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
26th November, 2009]
No.2(I)/2009-Pub, dated
26-11-2009.---The following Ordinance Promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:--
Whereas, it is expedient further to amend the
National Commission for Human Development Ordinance, 2002 (XXXIX of 2002);
And whereas, the National Assembly is not in session
and the President is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it
necessary to take immediate action;
Now, Therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred
by clause (1) of Article 89 of the Constitution of Islamic Republic of
Pakistan, the President is pleased to make and promulgate the following
Ordinance:--
2. Amendment of section 4 Ordinance XXXIX of 2002.---In
the National Commission for Human Development Ordinance, 2002 (XXXIX of 2002),
hereinafter referred to as the said Ordinance, in section 4, for subsection (2)
the following shall be substituted, namely:--
"(2) The Chairman shall, unless he resigns from
the office earlier, hold office for a period of three years and shall be
eligible for re-appointment for such term or terms as the President may
determine;
Provided that the Chairman shall cease to hold office
on attaining the age of sixty-five years or the expiry of term, whichever is
earlier?
